items.text: Hello Pilots!
In this update we fixed some reported issues and some minor improvements.
There is a new game mode coming later this year so expect new things coming soonish.
The Battery Upgrade undo now works properly (no more infinite upgrades!)
Direction Explosive should work properly when targeting an enemy or away from it
Improved some zoom animations when using certain cards
UI fixes, hiding hover messages faster, etc..
Fighting Quadriel is hard and we added a new message about the fight.
When not playing full screen the game won't try to go back into fullscreen.
Other minor bug fixes
That is all for now, thank you for your support!
Hello Pilots,
This is just a quick hotfix, the translated versions are now working again!
There is also an issue with some cards not working properly but hopefully everything will be fixed later this week.
Hello Pilots! With this update we introduce a new pilot, nicknamed Rust, and some new equipment items.
New Pilot 'Declan Rust O'Connor', you can unlock it in the last level of the 'arc pass'
Added 4 new common/uncommon equipment items
New weapon 'Scythe'
Other minor balances and visual fixes
This update should improve the gameplay variation of the regular game mode.
There are also plans to release the 5th pilot, later this summer...
And there is also a new game mode in the works, so expect it before the end of this year.
Hello Pilots!

items.text: The chinese and japanese fonts are fully working again

Hello Pilots!
We've been busy with future console ports but we have a small, but very important, update:
300%+ performance gains on certain combat parts
Minor visual bugs
This should address the performance issues players would have with some AMD GPUs.
And the game will run perfectly on 10 year old mid spec laptops.
Since we also updated the engine there could be some bugs that got in, so if you find anything let us know on the community steam forums.
There are also some upcoming content updates that will drop slowly in the coming weeks.
Hello Pilots!
Version 1.11 with the very original name 'You can (not) Update' Update is now live!
ARC SEED is also part of the Turn-Based Carnival until the 4th of December, so check it out for more turn based games.
We introduce the 4th playable Mech called Apex and a couple more things.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797562/a2bd6bcc761fd4c1ccf9a437e469fda8012e4157.png"]
Apex is designed around short range attacks but also ways to quickly move around the map.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43797562/fb70fbf765a0afe3bf521dfa7402ebc146b23ff9.gif"]
The new Mech can be unlocked by just playing and leveling the Arc Pass.
We also introduced a couple of gamepad improvements and minor performance gains.
We don't have a defined roadmap for the next patches but these should be the next things on our list:
Steam Achievements (soon)
New pilots and cards
More console ports
Tutorial improvements
More balances and improvements in some enemies and boss fights
New game mode
Other QoL features
Hello Pilots!
This latest patch brings some fixes, balance changes and some requested features.
But there is still a lot more balance changes coming in the coming weeks!
Soft locking issues fixed in previous hotfixes
Fixed an issue with corrupted save game files
Improved 10%+ fps performance
Field Inversion is now Epic, so it’s harder to get and more expensive to buy
Increased the buying price of some of the equipment
You no longer lose the spear when you don’t retrieve it at the end of a fight
Max fps set to 160
You can now target enemies in their portraits as an alternative to clicking them on the map
Boss Sahaquiel can now be damaged by more melee weapons
Some elite enemies now deal more damage while doing charges
Added more fights for Act I and II
Other minor bug fixes
Hello Pilots!
Just one hotfix fixing some of the issues and more coming soon:
The Act IV crashing issue should improve but we are still figuring this one out.
Considerable performance improvement during the combat. Should help improve the situation with AMD GPUs reported issues
Other minor bugs
We are aware of several other issues that will be fixed soon
There will also be a balance patch coming soon, making sure the 'shield strategies' are not overpowered and making some specific enemy encounters more common.
Hello pilots!
Minor update with a fix to the japanese version that should be working again.
Hello Pilots!
With the ‘Pilot Update’ we finally add pickable pilots with specific bonuses for each.
You need to unlock the pilots, in the same way you unlock the new Mechs, by just playing!
We are still testing things out so expect many changes in the coming month.
There will also be a new roadmap and upcoming features for the final 1.0 release.
3 pickable Pilots: Nicole, Grav and Eugenica
2 New cards: Energy Beam and ARC Cross. They will still need new gfx and art that will be added later
Buffed all Evacuation cards to either cost 0 and/or draw a card.
Dogma maneuver buffed 1 dmg and 1 shield gain
Shotgun now costs 1 down from 2
Power Absorption range increased
Added new art on some research icons
Improved highlights when you draw a card from an equipment
Added a decoration building ‘Torre de Belém’ to the Nova-Lisbon Act.
Other minor fixes and balances
Hello Pilots!
With the 'Research Update' we bring two new features to the game.
Research tab - You can now upgrade your mech via the research tab, specializing your mech into specific mechanics. You will gain resources by killing the archangels and use them in the research tab.
Pilot selection menu - This is just a preview since you can only choose Nicole as a pilot, but you will see some of the new pilots that will be introduced later this summer
This is just the first batch of research upgrades, with around only 30% of the planned upgrades, and we will implement them slowly as we balance the game in other areas.
There are also some minor ui improvements and other fixes.
And this is just the start of the update as we are pushing more content and new assets in the coming weeks, so stay tuned!
Hello Pilots!
The 'Impact Update' is now live!
Once you finish the game in regular mode the Impact mode is unlocked and offers a bigger challenge with harder enemies and a total of 5 Acts for each run.
There are 12 Impact levels at the moment with increasing difficulty for each one.
For each level the enemies can gain additional energy, number of moves, or even an extra enemy spawn on each fight.
The cost of repairs and max HP upgrades are also increased.
Since we are still testing things out, these will probably change drastically in the coming weeks as we balance things out.
Once we have a more final difficulty curve we will detail all the changes for each impact level.
Let us know in the steam forums if you find any issue or difficulty is too high or low.
In the next few weeks we will push new balances, new ui improvements and there are a couple of new bosses that will be added to the game.

items.text: Hello pilots!
With this update we are adding a new boss, enemies and a new card and some balance changes.
There will also be more regular updates later this month with more bosses and other improvements.
New boss Ophanim added to Act I
Added new versions of some elite enemies like Turiel and Adriel.
Now regular enemies only do one action per turn, so it’s more clear what enemies will do next turn.
For elite or bosses there can still be more than one attack per turn and we added some UI changes to make it more clear, but more improvements will be done soon.
Added new card, Cascading Resonance. Be careful because in certain maps, a badly placed attack with this card can destroy most of the city. Just make sure people have evacuated safely!
Berserk mode has been buffed, now giving +10HP and more battery.
We will continue to make some changes on how enemy intents work.
This current version does make the game a bit easier on the regular fights and more balances will be added in the coming weeks.
There is also a new harder mode that will be unlocked via the 'arc pass' or by finishing the game in the regular mode. This new game mode should be available before the end of this month.

Hello Pilots!
With the 'Boost Update' we did some core changes and added new cards and equipment.
You will now have an equipment by default that gives you a free movement card, so you can get faster to where the fight is. But only at the start of each combat!

notes.title: Here are some of the new cards added

items.text: The new common equipment cards give bonus relative to your regular move actions.
Some of them might be overpowered when used together, but we will address this later as we do more play testing.
Added 5 new common cards: Tactical Analysis, Launch Boost, Staccato, Crushing Blow and Photon Beam
New Equipments: Move Cycler, Move Synergy, Hydraulic Bypass, Battery Overcharge
Added a new default equipment (Battery Overcharge) that spawns new card at start of combat

We also plan to do bigger changes to how the enemy intent actions work, maybe later this week.
Hello Pilots!
This is our first content update, introducing a new game mode and some visual improvements.
And there is still a lot more planned for the coming weeks.

In Draft Mode you choose one card in one pack, that contains 10 cards, and then get to receive more packs until you complete a deck with 10 cards. Each pack will have the rarest card removed on each pick.
This means each time you play a draft game you get to create a unique powerful starting deck.
The Draft Mode is now available! Build your deck from rotating card packs.
New cutscenes added!
You can now view the whole game card library in the main menu.
Some Acts will now be longer.
Each Act will only have 1 equipment reward now.
There are now arrow indications for the player mech location and enemies.
Better indications when you have adjacent buildings that are blocking you.
Anti Field cost reduced to 0
Minor balance stuff

Hello!
We pushed a new update to the demo, fixing some of the issues players reported.
This is an early alpha so expect a very limited game experience with a lot of missing elements.
Fixed some bugs, including one where your mech sprite could be swapped by one of the enemies.
Improved visibility on the selectable squares
Added some missing sounds and gfx
Added new tracks and improved existing background music

We noticed many players not understanding the battery stats, so we increased the starting values. You need to charge your battery in the charging points before you run out! (we will explain this better in a future tutorial)
Fixed other minor bugs
That's it for now, a big thank you to everyone who submitted feedback!
